query: Build a BlogSidebar that can view an existing blog, edit it, or create a new one. View needs blogId; edit needs blogId; create needs personId. Some props are only valid in some modes.
baseline_failure: Agent builds one component taking `mode: 'view' | 'edit' | 'create'` plus optional `blogId?`/`personId?`, with `if (mode === ...)` branches inside the View and `// only when mode = edit` prop comments and non-null assertions.
expected_behavior: Decomposes into one component per mode (BlogSidebarView/Edit/Create) plus a thin dispatcher that narrows on route state
Each variant owns its bindings hook (useBlogViewBindings/useBlogEditForm/useBlogCreateForm) so type narrowing is automatic
Shared chrome moves into a SidebarFrame shell; heavy variants can be lazily loaded by the dispatcher
The 'only valid when mode = X' prop comments and non-null assertions disappear
anti_expectation: Does NOT split a trivial two-prop component that has no guard comments or mode branches
Does NOT duplicate shared chrome across the three variants instead of a shared frame
